Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Internationalism (see English sanatorium).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈsɑnɑtorio/, [ˈs̠ɑ̝nɑ̝ˌt̪o̞rio̞]
  • Rhymes: -orio
  • Syllabification(key): sa‧na‧to‧ri‧o
  • Hyphenation(key): sa‧na‧to‧rio

Noun

[edit]

sanatorio

  1. sanatorium

Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /sa.naˈtɔ.rjo/
  • Rhymes: -ɔrjo
  • Hyphenation: sa‧na‧tò‧rio

Noun

[edit]

sanatorio m (plural sanatori)

  1. sanatorium

Adjective

[edit]

sanatorio (feminine sanatoria, masculine plural sanatori, feminine plural sanatorie)

  1. curative
